biggest_catch: The $200 goes to the person who refers YOU, not to you — to earn the referrer payout you must already be an IBKR client with $2,000+ in your account and at least one securities trade. As the new account opener, all you get is about $1 of IBKR stock per $300 you deposit ($3 on a $1,000 deposit); the full $1,000 of stock requires depositing $300,000. And your referred friend's $10,000+ deposit must sit untouched for a full year before the referrer is paid.
catches: This is a referral-only program — IBKR has no public (non-referral) new-account deposit bonus. Both sides require the new account to be opened via the referrer's unique link.

Referrer $200 requires: the referred friend opens an individual or joint account via your unique link, deposits at least $10,000 within 30 days, AND maintains a balance of at least $10,000 for a full year.
Referrer eligibility: must be an IBKR client with an individual or joint account, account net liquidation value of at least $2,000, and at least one securities trade placed.
Referred friend earns $1 in IBKR stock per $300 deposited, maximum $1,000 of IBKR shares — an ordinary deposit earns a few dollars of stock.

Residents of Japan, Denmark, Spain, Portugal, Poland, mainland China, and Israel are ineligible; tax-deferred accounts are ineligible for both the bonus and the stock award; financial advisors, hedge funds, and institutional accounts are ineligible.
Canadian residents can refer and earn $200, but referred Canadian clients cannot receive the IBKR share award.

steps: To earn as the NEW account opener: get a referral link from an existing IBKR client and open your individual or joint IBKR account through that link — opening without the link earns nothing.
Deposit funds into the new account ($1 of IBKR stock per $300 deposited; a $1,000 deposit earns about $3 of stock, capped at $1,000 of stock for a $300,000 deposit).
To earn the $200 REFERRER payout: you must already be an IBKR client with an individual or joint account, at least $2,000 net liquidation value, and at least one securities trade placed.
Share your unique referral link; your friend must open via that link, deposit at least $10,000 within 30 days, and keep at least $10,000 in the account for a full year.
Confirm neither party falls under an exclusion (listed countries, tax-deferred accounts, advisor/hedge/institutional accounts).
timing: Exact credit timing not stated in the official terms excerpt reviewed.
